hooks.command:
printf '===== SESSION HANDOFF (HANDOFF.md) =====
Read this plus CLAUDE.md before starting work. Update HANDOFF.md before ending the session.

'; cat "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/HANDOFF.md" 2>/dev/null || echo '(HANDOFF.md not found)'

printf '
===== VOICE AND CRAFT CARD (AIOM_Voice_and_Craft_v1.md) =====
The standing voice rules are prohibitions. These six are the positive half, and
they bind from Stage 0, at drafting time, not from Stage 4. Read the full file
before drafting a chapter.

  C1 Concrete particular. Abstractions carrying argumentative weight are
     anchored to a named, specific instance. Bounded by the fifty-year rule.
  C2 Context and stakes. State the conditions that made a mechanism available
     and what it settles, not only what it does. No mechanical proxy exists.
  C3 Front-loaded sentences. Findings lead, qualifications subordinate, no
     throat clearing.
  C4 Deliberate rhythm. Sentence length varies. No long stretch at one length.
  C5 Paragraph close. End on the load-bearing clause, not a trailing qualifier.
  C6 The guard holds. No hero or villain framing, no populist register, no
     character-driven causation where a structural account is available.

Borrowed from Lewis, Lardner, the FT, and The New Yorker: the techniques only,
never the registers. C6 is what keeps the registers out.

'
